prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: Pilgrimage social cover, wide landscape 2.628:1 aspect ratio, designed for 1640 x 624 pixels.
Input image: style and brand-palette reference only. Create a NEW complete narrative scene in its exact hand-drawn medieval manuscript style. Remove ALL wordmark lettering and the large P; the scene itself fills the composition.
Subject: a small pilgrimage settlement gathering around its holy relic. A little gold reliquary casket with a cross is the focal point, resting on red altar cloth beneath the open rounded arch of a modest stone chapel. A brown-robed monk receives pilgrims arriving along a winding ochre path with wooden staffs and simple cloth bags. Around them: humble thatched cottages, a craftsman raising a timber wall, a small market with pottery and bread, a shepherd with two sheep, and small trees and garden plants. Tell one connected scene of people arriving, building, trading and tending the settlement.
Composition: fill the central area with the scene, comfortably framed by the reference's hand-painted green leafy vines, red flowers, muted blue leaves and gold flourishes on unbleached warm canvas. Focal chapel and relic near center, pilgrims approaching from left, village activities spread across the width. All essential figures safely within the inner 80% of the image. Balance dense tiny discoveries with clear silhouettes. No giant empty center.
Style: convincingly hand-painted by an early medieval biblical manuscript illuminator, as in the supplied reference. Uneven dark ink outlines, flat mineral-pigment color, simplified expressive faces and profile figures, slightly awkward anatomy, stacked ground bands and symbolic scale, sparse short hatch marks, canvas visible between strokes. Humble Romanesque rounded openings and early medieval vernacular construction. Small delicately drawn relic details, matte ochre gold accents.
Palette: deep forest green, parchment ivory, muted ochre gold, madder red, restrained dusty blue.
Constraints: absolutely NO letters, text, words, labels, wordmark, P symbol, watermarks or modern logo. No Celtic knotwork, modern polished vector illustration, smooth digital shading, painterly realistic lighting, 3D, cinematic perspective, fantasy castles, Gothic spires, elaborate late-medieval dress or plate armor. The image should feel like a small narrative folio from a monk's theological manuscript, not a modern rendition of medieval art.
